completedSummaries.after: Published in 2017, Snippets brings poetry, photography and moving image into a shared project by Vincent & Vincent, Olga Kovács, Péter Telekes and Norbert Bánhalmi. Its ISBN is 9786150000534.

completedSummaries.before: An archetype everyone thinks they know. Together with the women I worked with in Vienna we read it again from the beginning — and found something much…
completedSummaries.after: Femme Fatale was presented at CITYgalleryVIENNA in Vienna on 2 March 2025. The portrait series revisits the familiar archetype through the contrast between softness and strength.
completedSummaries.basis: Existing full introduction, header and bibliographic or historical record on this same page. No new dates, places or credits.

completedSummaries.before: New York changed the way I see. Not the way I shoot — the way I see. I photographed Hungarian women who had chosen that city as their own, and what.
completedSummaries.after: Hungarian Women in New York was presented at the Hungarian House in New York in 2014. The portraits bring together Hungarian women's experiences of the city, identity and belonging.
completedSummaries.basis: Existing full introduction, header and bibliographic or historical record on this same page. No new dates, places or credits.

completedSummaries.after: 50 Shades of Woman was presented at the Stefánia Palace in Budapest in 2015. The portraits explore the different emotions and roles that can coexist in a woman's life.
completedSummaries.basis: Existing full introduction, header and bibliographic or historical record on this same page. No new dates, places or credits.

completedSummaries.before: The most personal one. When my own world turned upside down, I did the only thing I know how to do: I picked up a camera and pointed it at other men…
completedSummaries.after: I Became a Father was presented at Bálna in Budapest in 2016. The black-and-white portraits focus on fathers with their children and the everyday gestures of care between them.
completedSummaries.basis: Existing full introduction, header and bibliographic or historical record on this same page. No new dates, places or credits.

completedSummaries.before: In New York I met people who carried 1956 in their pockets. Literally: photographs, a key, a christening spoon — the one object they grabbed on the way…
completedSummaries.after: Milestones ’56 combines fifteen portraits and life stories connected to the Hungarian Revolution of 1956 and emigration. The exhibition ran at the Hungarian House of New York from 22 October 2016 to 10 January 2017.
completedSummaries.basis: Existing full introduction, header and bibliographic or historical record on this same page. No new dates, places or credits.

completedSummaries.after: Das 2017 erschienene Buch Szösszenetek verbindet Lyrik, Fotografie und Bewegtbild. Es dokumentiert die gemeinsame Arbeit von Vincent & Vincent, Olga Kovács, Péter Telekes und Norbert Bánhalmi; die ISBN lautet 9786150000534.

completedSummaries.before: Ein Archetyp, den alle zu kennen glauben. Gemeinsam mit den Frauen, mit denen ich in Wien gearbeitet habe, haben wir ihn von vorne gelesen — und etwas…
completedSummaries.after: Femme Fatale wurde am 2. März 2025 in der CITYgalleryVIENNA in Wien gezeigt. Die Porträtreihe betrachtet den bekannten Archetyp neu und verbindet dabei Sanftheit mit Stärke.

completedSummaries.before: In New York traf ich Menschen, die 1956 in der Tasche trugen. Wörtlich: Fotografien, einen Schlüssel, einen Taufölffel — der eine Gegenstand, den sie auf…
completedSummaries.after: Meilensteine ’56 verbindet fünfzehn Porträts und Lebensgeschichten zur ungarischen Revolution von 1956 und zur Emigration. Die Ausstellung war vom 22. Oktober 2016 bis zum 10. Januar 2017 im Ungarischen Haus in New York zu sehen.
